answer: Every claim must carry its lineage: it cites the claimant's own previous verified claim, forming a chain to the first one, each verified claim adding a willow leaf to it. The payout desk follows the chain within a day; a claim with a broken or borrowed link is void. One honest user grows one chain over time, while 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 separate chains built from real verified history — a gap near 1,000 to 1. When one operator tried to graft a thousand fresh identities onto a single old chain, the desk stood on its knoll, saw one pigment seal on every link, and cut them all away.
